description:
Bundle of patches for Bejeweled 3 (com.ea.gp.bej3, 4.0.0 / 3.9.1).
- Ad-free: removes advertisement placements.
- Crash-guard: injects null guards across the Java glue layer.
- Privacy-disabled: disables telemetry consent tracking.
- Telemetry-disabled: suppresses analytics/tracking endpoints and severs the Kinesis/Cognito chain before AWS-HTTP consumers.
Developed with AI assistance; each patch statically verified at release time.
